EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Transparency Schema and Contract
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S1.description: Define response schema exposing matched_classifications, pipeline_origin (regex, vector, or both), confidence/attribution metadata, and ensure compatibility with existing provider search and evaluation response models.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S2.title: Implement Dual-Pipeline Attribution Logic
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S2.description: Extend specialty_service to tag each matched classification with its originating pipeline (regex, vector, or both), preserve attribution through deduplication, and ensure deterministic ordering of results.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S3.title: Propagate Transparency Through Facades and Tooling Layer
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S3.description: Integrate transparency fields into outputs of find_care_facade and evaluate_care_facade, and ensure tool_router safely passes structured attribution data through the LLM tool-use loop without breaking existing contracts.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Transparency
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S4.description: Add tests validating attribution correctness (regex, vector, dual), deduplication with attribution preservation, schema contract compliance, and end-to-end propagation from specialty_service through facades.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S5.title: Render Specialty Match Transparency in Chat UI
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S5.description: Update ChatWindow and MessageBubble to render specialty match explanations including pipeline origin (e.g., rule-based vs semantic match) in a user-readable format while preserving structured data semantics.
